annotations.title: arXiv search: preprints by topic, or one paper by ID

description: Search arXiv, the open preprint server for physics, mathematics, computer science and AI: give search words (every word must match, quotes for a phrase) and optionally a category such as cs.AI, and get 1-20 papers by relevance or newest first, each with title, abstract, authors, dates, categories, DOI and PDF link. An arXiv ID or link returns that paper. Use to find research on a topic, cite a paper or read its abstract before the PDF. Example: q=retrieval augmented generation. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

category.description: Optional arXiv category to search in, e.g. cs.AI, cs.CL, stat.ML, hep-th

q.description: Search words, or an arXiv ID or link (1706.03762, arxiv.org/abs/2401.01234)
